title: Downtown Nashville Home | Minutes to Broadway
description:
Walk to Hermes and Nashville’s hottest WeHo restaurants or drive just one mile to Broadway! 

This home is perfectly situated to experience all the best of Music City. One mile from Broadway (Honky Tonks, Live Music, Breweries, CMA Fest) , one mile from GEODIS soccer stadium, and just minutes from the Nashville hot spots (12 South, Midtown, The Gulch, East Nashville).

This charming home is perfect for couples, business trips, or small groups visiting Nashville.

The space
Owned by TN natives who love all things Nashville. This home was renovated in 2014 and is full of Nashville charm!

Furnished with all you need for the perfect Nashville getaway including a fully stocked kitchen. 

Hosts will provide coffee. 

With two queen beds and one twin bed, this home comfortably sleeps 5, but can accommodate up to 6 with couch or air mattress.

Other things to note
There are so many great places to eat, shop and listen to music in Nashville! Upon arrival, you will be provided with a list of the host’s favorites spots to help you decide on which places to visit during your stay.
